name: BLACK_WALL Preflight Guardrail
description: Pre-action risk check for OpenClaw tool calls. Hooks before_tool_call to call BLACK_WALL forecast(); in enforce mode, blocks STOP verdicts and (by default) blocks CAUTION verdicts with the named red flags, since this runtime has no interactive approval surface. Receipts are Ed25519-signed and verifiable offline.

apiKey.description: BLACK_WALL API key (bw_live_… / bw_test_…). Prefer the BLACKWALL_API_KEY env var over config.

baseUrl.description: BLACK_WALL API base URL. Defaults to https://blackwalltier.com.

mode.description: observe = log verdicts but never block; enforce = block STOP, gate CAUTION. Defaults to observe.

cautionAction.description: What a CAUTION verdict does in enforce mode. This runtime has no interactive approval surface, so: approve = block and surface the verdict + named red flags (so a human can re-decide out of band); block = veto with a generic reason; allow = proceed. Defaults to approve (block-with-detail).

failClosed.description: enforce mode only: when the gate is unreachable, block the action instead of letting it run unscored. Defaults to false (fail open). Recommended true for security-positioned deployments (e.g. NemoClaw).
